title: Event subscriptions
subtitle: Track durable custody separately from business results
unavailable: This source cannot start receiving now. Existing events can still be viewed and processed.
featureOff: New event reception is disabled. Existing events still need processing.
empty: No subscription is bound. Ordinary manual runs retain the saved input.
name: Name
testPassed: Connection verified; no group join, message custody or business execution.
newRequest: Close and review a new request
retryNote: For an unknown result, retry this request ID with unchanged parameters. Close and reopen to change its meaning.
replayNote: Processing again creates a new execution and preserves the original result. Original input and runtime settings are used by default. Stop receiving and settle existing work before choosing current settings.
skipNote: Records an unprocessed disposition. Original failures remain failures; an unaccepted source record may never reach business processing.
resetNote: Requires disabled reception, closed listeners and drained custody. A new epoch may reread or skip source history. Old custody/audit remain; target idempotency is required.
disableNote: Stop receiving new events. Received events continue processing; running executions are not cancelled.
enableNote: Start receiving with saved code, worker and account settings. Receiving an event does not mean processing succeeded. Save workspace changes first.
deleteNote: Deleting the binding retains historical events, executions and audit. Disable and drain first.
repairNote: Pause later dispatch and wait for running executions to finish. Only code and dependencies can be saved; original inputs, workers, accounts and later events keep their existing settings.
locked: The source is receiving or existing events still need processing. Stop receiving and settle existing work before changing runtime settings.
boundMode: A subscription is bound: delete it after disabling/draining before changing to scheduled triggers.
readOnly: You can view records. Editing settings and resolving problems require adapter edit access.
operationFailed: The operation did not complete. Refresh and inspect the current status.
originalState: Original results are preserved. Processing again is recorded separately.
gapNote: Control/aborted markers can produce conservative gaps. Do not advance to the client position automatically. UUID metadata checks are not an atomic Fetch fence.
initial: Which messages should be received first?
credentialNote: Choose an existing account. Passwords are not displayed. Manage accounts in system settings.
rangeNote: Only per_event + partition_serial; up to 16 exact topics and 16 accumulated partitions per epoch. Scope/initial-position changes require an explicit new epoch.
newEpoch: Confirm restarting reception; history may be reread or missed

errors.source_history_gap: Source history has expired. Review the impact before choosing a new starting point.
errors.source_checkpoint_ahead: Broker commits lead DLR custody; skipping is forbidden.
errors.source_authentication_failed: Authentication failed. Correct the Secret Store credential before resume.
errors.source_authorization_failed: Insufficient permissions. Review exact topic/group ACLs.
errors.source_tls_failed: TLS verification failed. Review CA and hostname.
errors.subscription_capacity_exceeded: Event storage or processing capacity is full. Process waiting events or inspect capacity in technical details.
errors.source_identity_changed: Source identity changed. Preserve old custody and review a new epoch.
errors.source_close_unconfirmed: Actual closure is unconfirmed; its permit remains occupied.
errors.subscription_binding_conflict: This Adapter already has an incompatible trigger or subscription binding.
errors.subscription_draining: Existing events still need processing. Inspect and resolve them in received events.
errors.subscription_config_conflict: The configuration version changed. Close this dialog, refresh and review a new request.
errors.subscription_owner_stale: Source ownership has been fenced; the old owner cannot accept more data.
errors.event_identity_conflict: The same event identity has different content. Reception is paused; inspect the source before continuing.
errors.event_payload_too_large: This event exceeds the size limit and has not been received. Inspect the source data or explicitly resolve this record.
errors.event_payload_expired: The original content has expired and cannot be processed again.
errors.source_not_available: This source cannot start receiving now. Check that the feature is available.
errors.source_connection_timeout: Connection diagnostics timed out. This alone does not prove an authentication failure. Actual client closure may still be pending.
errors.source_group_conflict: The dedicated consumer group conflicts with another consumer. Use an independent group.
errors.source_partition_limit: The source epoch exceeded its cumulative partition limit. Review scope and reset explicitly if appropriate.
errors.source_protocol_unsupported: The broker protocol or pinned client integration is unsupported.
errors.source_temporarily_unavailable: The source is temporarily unreachable; bounded backoff retries continue.
errors.source_credential_invalid: The account settings are incomplete or invalid. Check the existing account and retry.
errors.subscription_listener_not_closed: Actual listener closure is not confirmed. Keep its permit and wait.
errors.event_execution_active: An execution is still active; wait for its terminal result.
errors.event_replay_in_progress: This event already has an unfinished replay.
errors.event_disposition_conflict: This request ID was already used with different parameters. Preserve the original request or review a new one.
errors.source_epoch_required: Scope or initial-position changes require explicit confirmation of a new epoch.
errors.subscription_config_invalid: The source configuration is invalid. Review the closed field list and quota limits.
errors.source_permission_denied: Source LIST/WATCH permission was denied. Review scoped RBAC.
errors.source_object_invalid: The source object identity does not match the configured scope.
errors.source_list_invalid: The LIST page or collection snapshot is invalid.
errors.source_identity_unverified: This historical source identity cannot be verified; review an explicit new epoch.
errors.subscription_sync_history_capacity: The batch cannot reserve protected history. Review retained custody before a new LIST.
errors.subscription_sync_batch_capacity: The full batch exceeded its object or byte limit; its reconciliation is invalid.
errors.subscription_sync_completion_conflict: Completion responsibility changed, is active, invalidated or closed. Read back an existing request before creating a new one.
errors.subscription_sync_reserve_invalid: The prepaid control reserve is inconsistent. Preserve custody and ask an administrator to inspect quota accounting.
errors.subscription_sync_draining: The previous batch or its accepted responsibility must settle first.
errors.source_trust_invalid: API CA trust is invalid. Review the public CA bundle and server origin.
errors.source_list_snapshot_changed: LIST pagination no longer represents one consistent collection snapshot.
errors.source_response_too_large: The bounded source response limit was exceeded; the incomplete batch cannot authorize cleanup.
errors.source_member_skipped: A LIST member or started control was explicitly skipped; this batch cannot authorize cleanup.
errors.source_message_id_required: The message has no stable ID. Ask the producer to set message_id before resuming.
errors.source_properties_invalid: Message properties are unsupported or too large. Resolve this at the source.
errors.source_message_type_unsupported: Only normal RocketMQ 5.x messages are supported. Check the topic type.
errors.source_message_digest_invalid: Message integrity verification failed. Check the source message.
errors.source_message_encoding_invalid: Message encoding or compression is invalid. Check the source.
errors.source_queue_unavailable: The queue is unavailable or has another consumer. Check the queue and permissions.
errors.source_ack_failed: The message is stored but source acknowledgement failed. Redelivery will be deduplicated.
errors.ingress_capacity_unavailable: Receiving capacity configuration is unavailable or differs from the platform. Contact the deployment administrator; existing work can continue.
errors.ingress_disk_low: Persistent storage is low. New reception is paused. Ask the deployment administrator to free space; saved data continues processing.
errors.ingress_disk_unavailable: Persistent storage cannot be checked. New reception is paused. Contact the deployment administrator.
errors.subscription_batch_code_required: Save code that supports multi-event input, select This code supports several events per run in the editor, and save a new version before starting reception.
errors.subscription_replay_mode_conflict: The current processing mode differs from this event’s original mode. Process it again with the original runtime settings instead.

versionComparison: Original activation config v{{original}} → current config v{{current}}
resumeNote: Reconnects the same frozen activation and source epoch, reading current Secret Store values for the saved source credential reference. It does not skip blocked custody or apply workbench edits.
limitsInvalid: Enter a JSON object of supported positive integer limits within the deployment limits.
previewNote: Choose the code and review the worker and account references. A repair version changes only code and dependencies. Reprocessing with current settings is rejected if those settings have changed. Account passwords are never displayed.

kubernetes.originInvalid: Enter an HTTPS origin without credentials, API paths, query or fragment.
kubernetes.allNamespacesNote: All namespaces require matching cluster-wide RBAC and enlarge this managed scope.
kubernetes.perEventNote: Process received resource changes individually. Expired source history can only be recovered as current state.
kubernetes.stateSyncNote: Only waiting updates for the same object may merge. Full sync objects, deletion boundaries and existing executions do not merge.
kubernetes.credentialNote: Choose an existing access token; token values are not displayed.
kubernetes.rangeNote: Read current resources in the selected scope, then receive later changes. Expired history cannot be restored.
kubernetes.newEpoch: Explicitly create a new epoch for scope, mode or trust changes
kubernetes.resetNote: A new epoch starts a new complete LIST using this saved scope. Old custody and audit remain. No arbitrary resource-version advance or automatic target cleanup is requested.
kubernetes.confirmReset: Confirm a new full LIST epoch for this saved Kubernetes scope
kubernetes.gapNote: WATCH reconnects from the last durable RV. A 410 records a possible history gap and starts a new full LIST after old responsibility settles; it does not reconstruct expired changes.
kubernetes.testPassed: Bounded LIST/WATCH permission and trust checks completed; no DLR custody or business execution.
kubernetes.testResult: Logical cluster {{cluster}} · {{resource}} · {{namespace}} · scope {{scope}} · trust {{trust}} / LIST {{list}} / WATCH {{watch}}

errors.source_history_gap: The saved WATCH RV is no longer readable. Old responsibility must settle before a new LIST; expired changes cannot be reconstructed.
errors.source_credential_invalid: The source credential reference must provide a valid token field. Correct Secret Store values before reconnecting.
errors.source_authentication_failed: API authentication failed. Review the token credential reference.
errors.source_protocol_unsupported: The API response or pinned client integration is unsupported.

batch.title: Full synchronization batches
batch.separateFacts: A complete source read is not business success. Inspect batch processing and business results separately.
batch.abandonImpact: Existing target changes cannot be rolled back. This action only cancels the latest processing request that has not started and closes this completion confirmation. Other failures and received changes still need processing. Reception stays stopped; a new full sync will not start automatically.
batch.reasonBytes: The reason must not exceed 4096 UTF-8 bytes.
batch.confirmImpact: I understand that the business result remains unconfirmed and the target cannot be rolled back.
batch.closedReplayNote: Closed or abandoned completion cannot create a new replay. An existing request can only read back its original result; a new reconciliation requires a new complete batch.
batch.memberSkipNote: Skipping a LIST member or sync.started permanently invalidates cleanup eligibility for this batch. It records unprocessed responsibility; it does not mean target reconciliation succeeded.

ux.eventHint: Run the saved processing code when an event arrives.
ux.eventInput: Run input: received event content. Manual test input is saved separately.
ux.saveFirst: Save changes to code, runtime settings and input first
ux.codeFirst: Write and save processing code first
ux.workerFirst: Select and save a runtime worker first
ux.settleFirst: Wait for existing work to finish, or resolve the problem in received events
ux.saveSettingsFirst: Save the runtime settings below before configuring the source.
ux.testPassed: Connection test passed. Only source connectivity was checked; processing code was not run.
ux.help: Configure a source, write and save processing code, select a worker, then start receiving. Stopping reception only stops new events; received events still need processing. Inspect and repair failures in received events.
ux.unbindHint: Before switching modes, stop receiving, settle existing work, then explicitly disconnect the source in advanced settings.
ux.statusUnavailable: Event status could not be loaded. Refresh before relying on event filters.

status.stoppedWithWork: Reception stopped; existing events still need processing

ux.createManual: Run when you click the button
ux.createEvent: Run when data, messages, or resource changes arrive
ux.saveTestHint: Save the source settings, then check connectivity. Processing code is not run.
ux.savedTestFailed: Source saved, but the connection test failed.

createNote.event: Configure the source and save processing code after creation, then explicitly start receiving.
createNote.schedule: Configure the schedule and worker, then save the code. Creation does not start execution.

ux.unconfirmedBatch: The previous full sync completion was abandoned. Its business result remains unconfirmed; this does not mean synchronization succeeded.
ux.problemHint: Inspect the problem and failed record. Repair and process again; the original failure is preserved.
ux.stopBeforeRepair: Stop receiving at the top right and wait for running work to finish before repairing.
ux.kafkaIdentityHint: Provided by the Kafka administrator; must match the actual broker cluster identity.
ux.manualTestHint: Use the saved manual test input below, without reading a new source event. Testing is unavailable while reception or existing work is active.
ux.checkingStatus: Checking event sources. Please wait before changing the trigger mode.
ux.capacityPausedHint: Received messages continue processing and existing records are retained. View the received records or capacity details, wait for retained capacity to be released, or stop reception before changing this source’s limits.

repairExitNote: Continue processing already received events with their original code and runtime settings. The repair version applies only to the events you explicitly reprocess. Receiving new events stays off.

queues.identityHint: Choose a stable label for this messaging service, such as prod-orders. Reuse it for the same service.
queues.identityInvalid: Use letters, numbers, dots, hyphens or underscores.
queues.serverInvalid: Include a port and select credentials separately. Do not include credentials in the address.
queues.queueHint: Use an existing dedicated durable queue. DLR does not create queues. Prepare a new dedicated queue after cloning.
queues.groupHint: Ask the source administrator for an existing dedicated group. Do not share it with other applications.
queues.rabbitmqHint: Receive from an existing RabbitMQ queue. The producer must assign a unique message_id to each message. Messages are acknowledged only after durable storage.
queues.rocketmqHint: Receive normal RocketMQ 5.x messages through a gRPC Proxy. RocketMQ 4.x NameServer addresses are unsupported.
queues.rabbitmqServerHint: For example amqps://broker.example:5671. amqp is plain; amqps is encrypted.
queues.rocketmqServerHint: For example grpcs://proxy.example:8081. Ask your administrator for the port. grpc is plain; grpcs is encrypted.
queues.rabbitmqStartHint: Start with messages available in the queue, processing in receipt order. Problem messages pause receiving until resolved at the source.
queues.rocketmqStartHint: Continue from the group's current progress without resetting it. Process in receipt order. Unsupported or oversized messages pause receiving.
queues.recoveryHint: Stored messages can be retried. For an unstored problem message, stop receiving and resolve it at the source. Direct source skipping is unavailable.
queues.resetNote: Starting again clears the local deduplication scope and may process retained messages again. Source queue or group progress is not reset.
queues.confirmReset: I understand messages may be processed again and confirm starting again.

errors.source_epoch_required: The connection scope changed. Stop receiving, settle existing events, then confirm starting again in advanced connection settings.

http.hint: Let an external system send JSON data to this adapter. DLR saves the data first, then runs the saved code in order.
http.saveNote: Saving does not start receiving. Save the code and worker, then choose Start receiving.
http.credentialHint: Select an existing token account for the sender. The token value is never shown here.
http.pathHint: The sender adds this path to the externally reachable DLR address.
http.sendHint: POST uncompressed UTF-8 JSON. Send the receiving token in Authorization: Bearer and a fixed, unique data ID in Idempotency-Key.
http.retryHint: 202 means saved, not successfully processed. Retry with the original ID and bytes. 200 means already received; use the returned status_url to check processing.
http.capacityHint: Use {} for platform defaults. These limits apply only to this source and cannot exceed deployment limits. Stop receiving and settle existing work before changing them.
http.capacityFields: Supported positive integers: pending_count, pending_bytes, history_count, history_bytes, dedupe_count, rate.
http.checked: Receiving configuration and token reference checked. External delivery and business processing have not been tested.
http.help: Select a receiving token and save the source, code, and worker. Then start receiving. The sender must retain each fixed data ID and original body. Stopping reception still lets saved data finish processing.
http.resetNote: Stop receiving and settle existing work first. This creates a new receiving address. The old address only reads existing records with the current valid token; it cannot accept new data. Records and results remain. Update the sender address.
http.confirmReset: I understand the address will change and will update the sender.

errors.event_identity_conflict: This ID was already received with a different body. Retry its original ID and bytes, or use a new ID for new data. Other data can still be received.
errors.source_credential_unavailable: The receiving token is unavailable. Check the existing token account and access.
errors.ingress_disabled: Reception has not started. Existing records can still be queried.
errors.ingress_epoch_retired: The receiving address changed. This old path only reads existing records. Update the sender address.
errors.ingress_unavailable: New data cannot be received temporarily. Retry later with the original ID and body.

businessBatch.modeHint: Stop receiving and settle existing work before changing this. Saving does not start reception.
businessBatch.multiple: Several events per run (code support required)
businessBatch.codeRequired: Save code that supports multiple inputs before starting reception.
businessBatch.savedOnly: This only saves the mode. It does not change code or convert ordinary code into a multi-event handler.
businessBatch.markerHint: After checking the code, expand Multi-event code support in the editor, select This code supports several events per run, and save a new version. API callers can use the equivalent Runtime parameters marker below. The declaration does not change code.
businessBatch.exampleHint: This Python example only shows ordering and the result format. Replace process_one with a real, idempotent write for each event. The placeholder never reports success. Unclassified exceptions leave the result unconfirmed and later events unprocessed.
businessBatch.orderHint: Report success only after each business write completes. Stop at the first failure or unknown result and mark later events as not processed. Cancellation affects all unfinished events in this run.
businessBatch.receivingHint: A run may process several events together; each event keeps its own result.
businessBatch.cancelHint: These events share one run. Cancelling it affects every unfinished event in the run. Confirmed successes are preserved.
businessBatch.unknownHint: The result is unconfirmed and the target may already have been written. Check the target before processing the original ID and body again; do not assume it never ran.
businessBatch.notRunHint: An earlier event did not succeed, so this event was not processed. Resolve the earlier problem before processing this one again.
businessBatch.notStartedHint: This run was cancelled before it started. This event was not processed and can be processed again using its original mode.
businessBatch.failedHint: Inspect the execution, resolve the cause, then process the original ID again. The original failure remains.

codes.business_error: The processing code reported failure. Inspect the execution.
codes.target_unavailable: The target is unavailable. Check the target service before processing again.
codes.target_permission_denied: The target account lacks permission. Check the bound account and target access.
codes.target_identity_conflict: The target has this ID with different content. Verify the target before making changes.
codes.target_invalid_data: The target rejected this data. Check its fields and types.
codes.target_retry_exhausted: The target retry budget is exhausted. Confirm recovery before processing again.
codes.target_commit_unknown: The target commit is unconfirmed. Check the target before processing the original ID again.
codes.execution_cancelled: The run was cancelled. Unconfirmed effects need verification.
codes.execution_timeout: The run timed out. Check whether the target was written before processing again.
codes.worker_lost: The worker disconnected. Check its state and the target result.
codes.result_unavailable: The complete result is unavailable. Check the target before processing again.
codes.batch_result_invalid: The code returned an invalid per-event result. Fix the code before processing again.
codes.batch_output_truncated: The per-event result was too large to retain completely. Reduce the returned data.
codes.predecessor_failed: An earlier event did not succeed. This event was not processed.
codes.execution_not_started: The run did not start. This event was not processed.

businessBatch.codeDeclaration: This code supports several events per run
businessBatch.declarationHint: Select this only when the code processes events in order and returns a result for each event. Save a new version before starting reception. This declaration neither changes code nor starts a run.
businessBatch.invalidConfig: Runtime parameters are not a valid JSON object. Restore a valid version first; this control will not overwrite the draft.
